description: Variable rate centrifuge cone penetration testing in saturated fly ash models is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Jiarui Chen, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). This NHERI DesignSafe-CI project archives the experimental data and supporting documentation associated with the study “Centrifuge Modeling of Variable-Rate Cone Penetration Testing in Fly Ash and Its Implications for State Interpretation” by Jiarui Chen and Alejandro Martinez (DOI: 10.1061/JGGEFK.GTENG-14669.). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: centrifuge test, cone penetration test, fly ash, partial drainage, variable rate, soil characterization. Published 2026-08-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
